gameDescriptionHtml:
The Ultimate TrickShot Simulation with realistic physics! Experience a variety of trickshot with simple mouse controls. Some stages are difficult. Pushing the limits of your precision and patience. When you pull off a miraculous trickshot, you’ll roar with triumph!

Challenge Your Precision and Patience! – Perform breathtaking Trickshots that you’ve only seen in videos – all with your own hand.

Share Your Epic Trickshots – Every successful Trickshot is recorded as a replay video. Share your accomplishments with friends or the world on social media. Replay videos (MP4) are not supported by Steam Cloud.

Game Features

  • Master Precision: Use mouse controls to throw various objects and hit tiny targets.
  • Extremely Challenging: Even the smallest adjustment can completely change the outcome.
  • Time-Consuming Masterpieces: Some Trickshots may take tens of minutes or even hours to accomplish.
  • Ultimate Reward: Push through the difficulty, feel your skills improve, and enjoy an unmatched sense of accomplishment.
